instruction_covers: GenerativeImage(data=/config=) accept Mapping, string path, PathLike, readable text/binary stream; Mapping not limited to dict
mapping loads snapshot mutable content (isolation both directions)

save_data/save_config accept paths, PathLike, text/binary streams; path saves return abspath message; stream saves return Everything-seems-good; write failures return false-status with underlying error, stream stays open
snapshots round-trip data1/data2, f1/f2 + seed/start/step/stop incl. zeros, plot fields incl. size (JSON array, tuple in memory)
typed load failures with __cause__; samilaConfigError importable from samila
legacy defaults for missing plot/generate and single-f1/f2
label: sound
notes: Verified repo: samila/functions.py load_data/load_config only accept io.IOBase (no Mapping/path/PathLike/binary handling, no size, no deepcopy, no typed causes); save_data_file/save_config_file only open(path,'w') (no streams); samila/errors.py defines samilaConfigError but __init__.py exports only samilaDataError/samilaGenerateError. All new behaviours are explicitly stated. Load streams staying open is pre-existing (json.load never closes) so R3 covers the assert-not-closed checks.
